messages:
samir: quick heads-up: i'm prepping a minor doc correction for the 'usage analytics' dashboard labels. found two panels using 'requests/s' vs 'requests per sec' interchangeably which confuses localization. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4622

elaine: ah yes, l10n will hate that. please standardize on 'requests/s' and add tooltip copy that expands to 'requests per second'.

samir: done. also found a broken link to the billing guide in the migration section. updated link targets.

jon: can you add a short note about why we show 'effective rate' (after batching) vs raw TPS? support keeps answering the same questions.

samir: good idea 0ndash; adding a 2-line callout with an example calculation and a short GIF showing batch aggregation. will sanitize GIF.

billing-bot: Automated check: removed dollar figures. references to tiers look OK.

elaine: small nit: in the panel description, reference the sampling window used (30s) so users don't wonder about variance.

samir: added sampling window. docs-qa: can you run a quick linter + accessibility check on the GIF alt text?

docs-qa: running checks now. will ping results.

samir: thanks, hoping to ship this morning.
